Given a polynomial `P` of positive degree and a root `z` of its derivative, `derivRootWeight P z w` gives the weight of a root `w` of `P` in a convex combination that is equal to `z`.

files.t: Invariant measure on the upper half-plane
files.s: We equip the upper half-plane with a measure, defined as the restriction of the usual measure on `ℂ` weighted by the function `1 / (im z) ^ 2`. We show that this measure is invariant under the action of `GL(2, ℝ)`.
